REAL jig: finish W3, center X, profile L/R, per-side tolerance, obstruction intervals

g.text: 1. Select exact wet WALL versus NICHE factory item
2. Physically locate pipe, glass, valve exclusion
3. Place flush sill / head / two jambs / backing
4. Test actual tile + backer + membrane + mortar
5. Check 3in FINISHED left and right focal piers
6. Joint movement and edge/profile chosen by maker

svg.text: REJECT: any sub3in finished pier, blocked pipe/glass, insufficient NICHE wet authority or missing owner instruction.
No automatic payable changes; signed physical size and manufacturer system are separate procurement prerequisites.
